title: Cap cord broke loose after first fill up
text:
Cap cord broke loose after first fill up. I really wanted to like this water bottle. It's very visually appealing and glass is my preferred vessel. However, upon unboxing, rinsing out the bottle, filling it for the first time, placing the cap on it and then lifted it by the cord...which promptly broke loose on one end and the bottle slipped and nearly hit a tile floor (but didn't thanks to my lightning fast reflexes). As I lifted the caught bottle by the (now tether instead of a loop) cord, the other end came loose from the cap. Now I have bottle with no way to hook it onto anything.

The bottle holds water, though, so that is a plus, I guess.
